findings.message: Before the planned ifosfamide administration or restart, identify the actual supplied product and reconcile its current product information with NCCP. An unidentified product is not cleared by the regimen table.

Before planned ifosfamide, obtain actual serum creatinine and bilirubin in µmol/L plus AST, ALT and ALP with the applicable local ULNs. CrCl, an absolute AST alone or a partial panel cannot resolve the product restrictions.

Verify the current laboratory units and actual local AST/ALT/ALP ULNs before further ifosfamide. An automatically populated laboratory profile is not verification. Do not equate CrCl with serum creatinine or assume a conversion from the printed alternative creatinine units.
